scientific_integrity: An algebraic infinite-family proof is given; finite tests are corroborative only. No external independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to full m-by-2 finite-field matrix spaces, m>=2, not higher-column spaces or rank-metric subcodes. Standard rank-sphere Fourier transforms and Schoenberg positivity criteria are credited to earlier literature; distinct contribution is the exact two-column power/bandwidth phase boundary, optimal projective-line Hilbert realization and endpoint ranks. Possible historical exact specialization remains a priority risk.
title: Sharp negative type and Gaussian bandwidth transition for two-column rank metrics
